relationships.subject: CGRP mAbs
relationships.evidence_quote: All the CGRP mAbs used in the present study improved the HIT-6 score from baseline at V3.

key_findings: In 68 Japanese migraine patients, CGRP mAbs reduced monthly migraine days from 13.4 to 7.4 after 3 doses (50% response rate 50.0%).
Response after the first two doses predicted response at the third dose; no serious adverse events.
